# PC Lab Kit
> Local-first PC diagnostic lab — PHP web UI + Windows probe. Health scan, history, benchmarks, stress, RGB, optional AI advisor. No cloud account required.

## Summary
PC Lab Kit is a standalone local laboratory. Clone the repo, install PHP deps, start the web lab, and optionally run PcLab Probe on Windows for real sensors.

## Install
- Clone: https://github.com/drmikecrypto/pc-lab-kit
- Windows probe ZIP: `pc-lab-kit-probe-windows.zip` (build with `scripts/build-agent-bundle.ps1`)
- Releases: https://github.com/drmikecrypto/pc-lab-kit/releases/latest
